Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 44 (QTS missing-address campaign): matched a generic row sharing this campus name to the one confirmed unified campus address rather than guessing among as many as sixteen internally coded buildings.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] QTS Data Centers, formerly QTS Realty Trust, is a large scale data center provider. Per Blackstone Real Estate Income Trusts own press release, Blackstone affiliated funds completed a roughly 10 billion dollar acquisition of QTS Realty Trust on August 31, 2021, taking the company private. This specific row is one of four entries in this registry all named simply QTS in Fayette County, GA, part of this operators Fayetteville megasite. A Baxtel listing for this campus, fetched fresh this session, gives 1435 Hwy 54 W, Fayetteville, Georgia, and explicitly describes a 615 acre site planned for up to 16 buildings, DC2 through DC16, that use internal building codes rather than separate street addresses, all part of the unified Fayetteville campus. Data Center Dynamics trade press separately corroborates a 250 megawatt mega-project at this same site. Given the operators own building numbering does not carry distinct street addresses, this session applied the one confirmed campus address to all four rows rather than guessing at which specific building each represents.
